question: Active contract backtest-certification-1.0.0 names SETUP_BACKTEST.requirements.independentWeeks=20; the producer counts distinct calendar months (date.slice(0,7)). Which count is normative?

projectionIfPublicationContinuesWeekly.interpretation: Under an ISO-week reading the independence gate would no longer be the binding constraint (M6 maturity, 100 completed outcomes, 120 dates and 180-day span bind later or similarly). Under the month reading it binds until roughly 2028-04-01. The choice therefore changes the earliest possible certification date by more than a year.

recommendation.option: B: adopt contract 1.1.0 with an explicit ISO-week counter (ISO week-year) for the gate named independentWeeks, keep the legacy month count as audit field
rationale: The contract text names weeks; the code deviates. Correcting code to text is the minimal normative change.

Neither count proves statistical independence. Add a mandatory companion requirement: setup outcome inference must use calendar-week clustered (or calendar-block) uncertainty, and overlapping M6 windows must be reported.
All other gates (M6 maturity, 100 completed outcomes, 20 titles, 120 dates, 180 days, OOS >= 30 per segment, total return, owner approval) remain unchanged.
recommendation.alternativeA: Keep months and rename the contract field to independentMonths (stricter, ~18 additional months).
recommendation.notRecommended: Any count of event days (20 already reached) — event days within one season are strongly dependent.

requires: Explicit owner approval; then a separate PR changing quant/methodology/backtest-certification-v1.json to 1.1.0 and build-backtest-certification.mjs with before/after.
